text:
Tabular numbers are digits that all take up the same width, so a 1 is as wide as an 8. That makes columns of prices line up neatly and stops a changing counter or timer from wobbling sideways.

AI mockups almost always leave prices, tables and timers on the font's default proportional digits, because nothing in a typical prompt asks for anything else. The mistake only shows once real numbers stack in a column or start ticking, which a static mockup rarely tests.
demo_html:
$1,111.11
$8,808.00
$417.90Wrong: proportional digits, columns drift
$1,111.11
$8,808.00
$417.90Right: tabular digits, columns line up
prompt_line: Use tabular numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) on every price, table column, counter and timer so the digits line up and don't jitter.
